item.title: U.S. women's hockey captain ties goal record at 2026 Winter Olympics
item.description: Olympian and U.S. ice hockey captain Hilary Knight tied the record for the most career Olympic goals on Saturday, making team history and cementing the U.S.'s 5-0 win over Finland.
